title: CoReFlow: Consistency-Relaxed Flow Maps for Probabilistic Traffic Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.05715v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Probabilistic traffic forecasting is essential for reliable Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), as it captures uncertainties in complex road networks. Recent diffusion- and flow-based generative models have facilitated uncertainty modeling through a multi-step sampling process. However, beyond slow inference, this process is designed to capture complex multimodal distributions, which misaligns with the limited complexity of the conditional traffic data distribution, causing models to underperform deterministic baselines. To address this, we introduce the \underline{Co}nsistency-\underline{Re}laxed \underline{Flow} Map (CoReFlow) model, presenting the first effort to leverage the one-step generation capability of flow maps, known as solution operators of probability-flow ordinary differential equations. Besides, we improve accuracy using a concise training objective that supervises the model via interpolation endpoints over finite t

translated_title: CoReFlow：用于概率交通预测的一致性松弛流映射
translated_abstract: 概率交通预测对于可靠的智能交通系统（ITS）至关重要，因为它能够捕捉复杂路网中的不确定性。近年来，基于扩散模型和流模型的生成式模型通过多步采样过程实现了不确定性建模。然而，除了推理速度慢之外，该过程本意是捕捉复杂的多模态分布，这与条件交通数据分布相对有限的复杂度并不匹配，导致模型表现不如确定性基线。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一致性松弛流映射模型，这是首次利用流映射单步生成能力的工作，流映射即概率流常微分方程的解算子。此外，我们通过一个简洁的训练目标来提升精度，该目标通过有限时间步上的插值端点对模型进行监督。
tldr: 提出CoReFlow模型，首次将流映射的单步生成能力应用于概率交通预测，解决了扩散和流模型多步采样推理慢且与交通数据分布复杂度不匹配的问题，并通过简洁的训练目标提升了预测精度。
en_tdlr: CoReFlow is proposed as the first model to leverage the one-step generation capability of consistency-relaxed flow maps for probabilistic traffic forecasting, addressing slow inference and distribution mismatch in diffusion/flow models while improving accuracy through a concise training objective.
